programme: The twelve concordant factors do not resolve into one complex or pathway. They span at least six unrelated regulatory families with no shared partner, no shared signal, and no overlapping target logic: CREB/ATF bZIP stress-responsive factors (ATF1, CREB3L4), an AP-1 bZIP (FOSL2), the Wnt/TCF effector TCF7, the oxidative-stress factor NFE2L2, the BTB/POZ epigenetic silencer HIC1, the EMT/glycolysis zinc-finger KLF8, the nuclear-receptor corepressor NCOR1, the bHLH-PAS factor NPAS1, the Nodal/TGF-beta effector FOXH1, the B-cell coactivator POU2AF1, and the CP2/LSF factor TFCP2. Grouping these as one 'module' would be assembling a mechanism from co-occurrence alone.
role_in_a: No role is supported. None of the twelve factors carries an Open Targets association with Cardiovascular_Disease, and no retrieved paper places any of them in cardiovascular tissue or pathology.
role_in_b: A minority have direct, disease-specific gastric-cancer evidence, but each through its own disconnected mechanism rather than a shared axis: ATF1 phosphorylation promotes metastasis via MMP2; HIC1 promoter methylation silences a tumor-suppressor/CD8+-infiltration axis; KLF8 drives glycolysis via GLUT4 and correlates with poor prognosis; TCF7 acts through Wnt/beta-catenin and is upregulated by YTHDF1 to support proliferation; CREB3L4 knockdown sensitizes cells to cisplatin via autophagy. NCOR1, FOSL2, NPAS1, NFE2L2, TFCP2, FOXH1, and POU2AF1 have no gastric-cancer-specific support in this record.
shared_axis: None can be defended from the material given. The five factors with any disease evidence support five separate, non-overlapping gastric cancer mechanisms (metastasis, epigenetic silencing, glycolysis, Wnt signaling, chemoresistance), and there is no retrieved link, direct or indirect, to cardiovascular disease for any of the twelve.
reasoning: No complex or pathway unifies the concordant set, so there is no programme to name at the factor level as the rules require. The record itself confirms this is not a retrieval artifact: Open Targets returns nothing for any factor against Cardiovascular_Disease, and only 5 of 12 factors have any gastric-cancer-specific citation, each supporting a different, unconnected mechanism. Forcing a story here would violate the instruction to let incoherent stand when the factors are not a mechanism.
support: PMID 35397606 (ATF1 phosphorylation promotes metastasis and MMP2 expression in gastric cancer); PMID 40279559 (HIC1 suppresses tumor progression and promotes CD8+ T cell infiltration in gastric cancer); PMID 35276239 (HIC1 promoter hypermethylation drives its downregulation in gastric cancer); PMID 31124603 (KLF8 associated with poor prognosis, regulates glycolysis via GLUT4 in gastric cancer); PMID 41895780 (small-molecule Wnt/beta-catenin inhibitor tested in a TCF7-linked gastric cancer context); PMID 38538279 (YTHDF1 upregulates TCF7 to promote gastric cancer cell proliferation and inhibit apoptosis); PMID 42098970 (CREB3L4 knockdown reduces cisplatin resistance via autophagy in gastric cancer cells). None found for Cardiovascular_Disease for any factor.
how_to_falsify: Run ChIP-seq or co-IP for ATF1, HIC1, KLF8, TCF7 and CREB3L4 in gastric epithelial cells and in vascular/cardiac or PBMC samples from cardiovascular-disease cohorts: if they co-bind a shared set of loci or physically complex together, and if several show concordant differential expression or activity in CVD blood/vascular samples versus controls, the 'no shared programme, no CVD evidence' call here is wrong and should be revised toward a real shared axis.
caveats: The tissue pairing (blood for CVD vs. stomach tumor tissue for gastric cancer) is itself a mismatch — blood is a surrogate/bulk sample for a vascular/cardiac disease, not diseased tissue directly, which weakens any shared-mechanism claim before the factors are even considered. The 240 patient-group comparisons come from only 2 independent cohort pairs, so the recurrence counts likely reflect structure within two cohorts rather than 240 independent replications. The tissue-generic exclusion list removed the classic blood/immune master regulators (STAT1, IRF8, PRDM1, TBX21, ID2/ID3, FOXO1, MEF2C), which would have been the most natural candidates for a blood-stomach shared immune axis — their absence is by design, not oversight, and it leaves the lymphocyte-linked survivors (POU2AF1, TCF7) without an immune-programme context. HIF1A appears only in the single-view discard list, which rules out treating NPAS1's ARNT partnership as evidence for a hypoxia master-regulator story.
